purpose: Two-dimensional animation feasibility demo; not a copy of Kairosoft assets

files.prompt: Create a PRODUCTION 2D sprite animation sheet, not concept art. ORIGINAL medieval European villager, charming compact pixel-art simulation game aesthetic, 2.5 heads tall, big readable friendly face, short body. Exact rectangular grid SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, 18 isolated full-body cels, ALL slots filled. Wide landscape sheet, transparent alpha background absolutely no floor or shadows, no white/checkerboard rectangle, no text, no grid lines. Every cell same dimensions, identical character SCALE across all 18 cels, feet at same baseline within cell, centered with roomy padding for tools. All cels face RIGHT in a three-quarter view (we see face and front of torso, feet move toward right). Outfit MUST remain exactly identical: small tan straw hat with dark brown band, chestnut hair, cream shirt, forest green overalls, brown ankle boots, peach skin. Pixel art with purposeful square pixel clusters, warm dark-brown 1-2 pixel contour, few clear cel shades, coherent pixel size, NO airbrush, NO 3D, NO photographic textures. At original logical scale approximately 40 by 56 pixels per character, enlarged clean nearest-neighbor pixels for display. Artisan quality, expressive carefully designed silhouette, not crude primitive shapes. ROW 1: SIX sequential frames of a looping WALK cycle, IN PLACE, no carried objects: left contact, down passing, right contact, right down, left passing, recovery. Hands swing gently, feet visibly alternate, hat/body remain same size and height except 1 logical pixel bob. ROW 2: SIX sequential frames of the SAME WALK cycle but CARRYING TWO SHORT LOGS horizontally in both arms in front of torso. Logs fixed relative to arms, arms held forward around chest/waist, not swinging, legs alternate. Same exact outfit and hat. ROW 3: SIX sequential frames of CHOPPING WOOD in place with a small axe, no stump drawn: ready holding axe in both hands, axe raised above right shoulder, highest raised anticipation, strong downward swing extending to the right at knee height, low impact follow-through, recovery back to ready. Hands stay gripping wooden handle. Head and outfit do not change. NO logs in row3, no extra detached props. Make chopping physically readable and different frames, not six identical poses. Row1 no axe or logs. Row2 only logs. Row3 only axe. Transparent space between EVERY cel, no overlap or cropped hats/tools. Keep consistent tiny character identity through all 18 frames, every cel a single complete person, no duplicates inside a cell.

Production 2D sprite sheet for an original cozy medieval strategy game, crisp warm pixel-art cels, absolutely NO 3D render. EXACTLY FOUR columns and THREE rows = TWELVE distinct animation cels, rectangular landscape canvas with transparent alpha background. No text, numbers, grid, ground, shadows or checkerboard. All cells same size, 25% EMPTY padding around each cel: EVERY sword/shield/helmet stays completely inside its own cell with visible transparent gaps on ALL four sides. Character 2.5 heads tall, friendly readable face, simple silver-gray open-face helmet with brown hair and peach face visible, BLUE tunic with brown belt, charcoal trousers, brown boots, small round blue shield rimmed with brass on left hand, short steel sword on right hand. Exact same knight identity, outfit, colors, body size in every cell. Consistent game pixel scale with deliberate hard square clusters, dark warm-brown thin pixel contour and 2-3 cel shades; polished authored character design, no sketch or photographic texture, no realistic anatomy. All cels facing RIGHT in a slightly elevated three-quarter view, we see front/side of face and torso. Original character not copied from an existing game. ROW ONE: four sequential frames of in-place walking with sword held low and shield at chest, feet alternate contact-passing-opposite-contact-passing. ROW TWO: four sequential frames of a SINGLE SWORD ATTACK: 1 wind up sword held raised behind right shoulder with shield forward, 2 highest anticipation and slight backward lean, 3 strong horizontal forward slash to RIGHT with arm extended and sword tip well INSIDE cell, knees flexed, 4 follow-through low sword and recovery. CLEARLY different arm/sword silhouettes in each frame; no huge detached swoosh in the sprite. ROW THREE: four sequential HURT/BLOCK frames: 1 shield raised front to block, 2 recoil backward with closed eyes and shield high, 3 recovery with knees bent, 4 return to steady guard. No gore, wounds or death. Keep SHOES on the same baseline across all 12 cells. Top of head same relative height except modest 1-pixel bob or deliberate recoil. Whole figure fits in 65% of each cell width including sword and shield, important for animation cutting. Every cell contains exactly one complete warrior, limbs intact, no extra weapons or detached parts.

Create a polished ORIGINAL 2D PIXEL ART GAME BACKGROUND for a cozy European medieval simulation animation test, wide landscape 3:2 or 16:10 composition. This is a usable background asset with NO people, NO UI, NO text, NO logos, NO border. Elevated three-quarter 2.5D orthographic game view, consistent readable chunky pixel clusters and warm thin dark-brown pixel contours. Not a 3D render, not realistic, not smooth painterly. Warm red-orange roof tiles, cream plaster, dark-brown timber, sage grass, pale ochre compacted-earth yard. Upper half: a charming modest timber-frame cottage at upper left, attached open carpentry shed with wood bench and neatly stacked logs, leafy round pixel trees behind it. Far upper right: low medieval stone wall and a small wooden archery target, banners with simple solid blue cloth, flowers and a bush at the edges. Keep all large architecture in UPPER 55% of image; no overhead sky, all ground-level isometric scene. Lower 45%: spacious mostly EMPTY level compacted-earth workshop/training courtyard, enough clear ground to animate two characters approaching each other horizontally, only a few tiny carefully placed pebbles/grass tufts, no grid, no maze of roads. A small LOW LOG PILE at 22% image width and 70% image height, and one single LOW CHOPPING STUMP at 75% image width and 70% image height, both props deliberately small, below a person's knee, not tall obstacles. Center foreground from 30% to 67% image width is empty earth for the characters, no props or fences blocking it. Gentle stylized tree shadows mostly at edges, simple cel shading, no photography texture or gritty noise. Every roof and foliage silhouette meticulously designed, artisan pixel game environment. Logical pixel size consistent across whole image, roughly as if drawn at 480px width then enlarged nearest-neighbor, no isolated high-resolution details. The building scale supports foreground residents approximately 15% of image height, 2.5-head chibi bodies. Entire image fills canvas opaquely. Original medieval world, no borrowed videogame assets.
